events.text:
I worked out a route that wins; the checker confirmed it ("WON after 108 moves"). That cost one of the 40 rule-tool calls.

**The problem:** the trader can't walk to the door island (around the door at 18,12). The bridge needs four crystals sunk in water, and the level starts with one. The plan uses the two mirrors to copy the crystal.

1. **Reach the middle island:** Push mirror #2 west to (14,23) and walk the trader to (19,23). Pressing X reflects the trader 5 cells up to (14,18).
2. **Set up the copier:** Push mirror #4 west to (12,18). Then push the crystal around to (14,18). There, mirror #2 sees it 5 cells to the north and mirror #4 sees it 2 cells to the east.
3. **Copy:** Pressing X sends the crystal to (19,23) and puts a copy at (12,16).
4. **Build the bridge:** Push each copy east along row 16 to (16,16). Then push it north until it sinks at the next open water cell in column 16: first (16,15), then (16,14), then (16,13).
5. **Repeat:** One X brings the crystal at (19,23) back to (14,18), and a second X copies it again. The copy at (12,16) has to be moved out of mirror #4's view first, or two crystals would land on the same cell and merge into one.
6. **Finish:** After the third copy, one more X brings the original crystal back to (14,18). Push it east to (16,18), then north up column 16 until it sinks at (16,12). The trader walks over the sunk crystals to (16,12), then east to the door at (18,12).
